guide_passage: The younger state can look at the grown-up life and say, “I don’t trust you.” The adult can answer, “I believe you. And I love you.” Trust is allowed to examine old promises, continuing self-attack, and failures of protection. Love does not have to wait for trust to issue a favorable verdict.
